name: query_data
title: Query data
description: Reads a data source to answer in text. Results are truncated to 20 rows; prefer a narrower source or parameters to reading everything.

range.description: Relative period of the games. Never an absolute date.

lastGames.description: Only the N most recent games. Use instead of range when the player counts games.

mode.description: Game mode: normal (vs on-device bot), classe (ranked vs server bot, Elo), multi (online vs a human). Omit for all modes.

opponent.description: One opponent, copied verbatim as it appears in data or in the request (a token such as [Player:1], or a bot name such as Expert).

only.description: all = every disc played, winning = only discs of winning four-in-a-row lines.

limit.description: Only for games.recent: number of rows. Other sources have no limit (query_data already truncates to 20 rows).

starter.description: Only for games.pivot: keep only the games where this side played first.

groupBy.description: Only for games.pivot: dimension of the rows (one row or bar per value). column = column of the player's first disc, moves = game length, starter = who played first, week/month = calendar period.

splitBy.description: Only for games.pivot: optional second dimension, one series per value (chart color). Must differ from groupBy.

measure.description: Only for games.pivot: value computed for each group. winRate in %, avgMoves = average number of moves, eloDelta = sum of Elo changes (ranked only).
